scripts.test: npm run test -w @arquifusion/backend && npm run test -w @arquifusion/frontend && npm run test:python
scripts.build: npm run build -w @arquifusion/backend && npm run build -w @arquifusion/frontend && npm run build:python
scripts.build:python: python -m compileall -q cloud/gcp/intelligence/src cloud/azure/intelligence && python -c "import json; json.load(open('packages/contracts/events.schema.json', encoding='utf-8'))"
scripts.infra:validate: npm run build -w @arquifusion/backend && npm run validate:infra -w @arquifusion/backend
